build_log.first_build_log_note: the first build.log (faulthandler on) ended with 25 'Windows fatal exception: access violation' reports after the stage marker, exit code 0; the regenerated log has none
build_log.explanation: With an empty script, Blender reports first-chance access violations on its main thread during its own exit (after the script, before Python finalisation) only when faulthandler is on, and exits 0: Windows faulthandler logs exceptions from a vectored handler, i.e. before the process's own exception handlers deal with them (the process goes on to atexit and exits 0). They do not come from the Harpy build; the build keeps faulthandler off unless --faulthandler is given.
build_log.earlier_real_crash: EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION in blender::property_string_get from the vertex-group removal loop copied from Merlin (non-zero exit, no stage marker); fixed before the first successful build, unrelated to the exit-time reports
